title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 100 Calle Alondra in San Juan, Puerto Rico, as the 65th Infantry Regiment Post Office Building.
official_summary: Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 100 Calle Alondra in San Juan, Puerto Rico, as the "65th Infantry Regiment Post Office Building."

summary.headline: Names a post office building in San Juan, Puerto Rico, after the 65th Infantry Regiment.
summary.what_it_does: This law gives an official name to the Postal Service facility at 100 Calle Alondra in San Juan, Puerto Rico. The building will be called the "65th Infantry Regiment Post Office Building." It does not change how the post office operates, its services, or its staff.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 13, 2019.
